notes.title: New kooky game released!!
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2650510

Welcome to another kooky game! This time, you will explore the lands of Aotearoa and discover all the hidden quirky elements throughout the game which is full of challenges, histories and, most importantly, fun!

Bundle includes 3 games along with this new one: 

It's Kooky - Land of Aotearoa
100 Hidden Kooky - Sand & Sun
It's Kooky

notes.title: 100 Hidden Kooky - Sand & Sun is now released
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2746760


Find 100 hidden silly characters with unusual behaviours in the beach and an additional 100 sunscreen bottles to complete the game. Also play mini challenges to get help with your quest.

notes.title: Beta_version_2.1.0
notes.notes:
[h1]RELEASE NOTES[/h1]
This is applicable to both Windows and Mac version.

[h2]Steam Achievements[/h2]
-Players will now be able to unlock steam achievements for every level they complete. 
-There will be a total of 12 achievements, where each will unlock when you spot every single silly item in every level.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
-Cursor disappearing issue on Mac devices have now been solved.
-Tutorial section is more robust and straight forward.
